title: Optimization of two-photon excitation by indistinguishable photons in a three-level atom
summary: We investigate the excitation of a three-level ladder-type atom by a unidirectional field with a pair of indistinguishable photons. Starting from an analytical expression for the two-photon absorption probability, we determine the two-photon state that maximizes the population of the upper atomic state at a chosen time and show that in the limit of an infinitely long pulse, perfect excitation is possible.
